say:1:1123106001:1.text: Stop being so noisy! Just take what you want! No need to disturb an old man at death's door.
say:1:1123106001:1.source_cn: 吵死了！想拿什么就拿吧！何必打扰我这将死的老人。

say:3:1123106002:1.text: Hey! You can hear us, after all! But wait, we aren't thieves!
say:3:1123106002:1.source_cn: 什么！原来你听得见！啊！不对，我们才不是强盗！

say:4:1123106003:1.text: Thieves... Hmph! Even if you were here to steal, I have nothing you can take anyway.
say:4:1123106003:1.source_cn: 强盗，哼。\n就算你们想抢，对于我来说也没有什么真正能...

choice_prompt:6:1123106003.text: Thieves... Hmph! Even if you were here to steal, I have nothing you can take anyway.
choice_prompt:6:1123106003.source_cn: 强盗，哼。\n就算你们想抢，对于我来说也没有什么真正能失去的了。

say:7:1123106004:1.text: Why does Kruger bother with me? Even if he's the chief now, I haven't been a member of the Grimmaw Clan for many years.
say:7:1123106004:1.source_cn: 克鲁格与我有什么关系？即便他现在是族长，我也早就不是黑...

say:8:1123106005:1.text: I'm just a drop of tainted blood from the honorable Grimmaw Clan. If tainted blood flows back, it'll only infect the wound. Can't you youngsters grasp this concept?
say:8:1123106005:1.source_cn: 我不过是黑嚎氏族滴下的一滴污血罢了。\n污血再流回去也...

say:9:1123106006:1.text: Many things are impossible to undo once set in motion.
say:9:1123106006:1.source_cn: 很多事情一旦过去，就无法回头了。

say:11:1123106007:1.text: But there are many wild beasts nearby! It's too dangerous to stay here!
say:11:1123106007:1.source_cn: 可是，这附近似乎有一些野兽，留在这里好危险！

say:12:1123106008:1.text: Pah! Outlanders will never understand. Even if I return, I won't be able to contribute to the clan. If weakness and dignity cannot coexist, then I simply choose the latter.
say:12:1123106008:1.source_cn: 外族人是不会懂的，即便我回去也无法对氏族做出贡献。\n...

say:13:1123106009:1.text: Go back... This is not where you belong. If anyone asks, you never saw me.
say:13:1123106009:1.source_cn: 回去吧，这不是你们该来的，你们也没有见到过我。

choice_prompt:14:1123106009.text: Go back... This is not where you belong. If anyone asks, you never saw me.
choice_prompt:14:1123106009.source_cn: 回去吧，这不是你们该来的，你们也没有见到过我。

say:15:1123106010:1.text: Take it with you... It's of no use to me. Now leave an old man in peace!
say:15:1123106010:1.source_cn: 带走吧，就算留在这里，我也不会用的。快离开，不要再打扰...

choice:14:0:1.text: ... We'll leave this and go for now.
choice:14:0:1.male: ... We'll leave this and go for now.
choice:14:0:1.female: ... We'll leave this and go for now.

choice:6:0:1.text: Kruger asked us to come here.
choice:6:0:1.male: Kruger asked us to come here.
choice:6:0:1.female: Kruger asked us to come here.

choice:6:1:2.text: Here are supplies from the Grimmaw Clan.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我们来为你送黑嚎的补给
choice:6:1:2.male: Here are supplies from the Grimmaw Clan.
choice:6:1:2.female: Here are supplies from the Grimmaw Clan.
